title: Close-range B-B pair at separation 1.0, at rest: attractive K/r^2.5 law with K = 3.98 (T <= 0.15)

claims.statement: Two B particles at rest, initial separation 1.000 (within 0.001), duration at most 0.15: each accelerates toward the other with magnitude K / r^2.5 (r the current separation, P = 2.5 fixed) and K = 3.98 held constant over the run (attractive; chamber and time units). Pooled over three lab-b runs; the run-to-run spread is consistent with the per-run fit error.
